data.name: Ansar
data.gender_notes: Ansar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ansar refers to the 'helpers' of Medina who supported the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and the Muhajireen (emigrants) during Hijrah. It is a title of honor and selflessness rooted in Islamic history and mentioned in the Quran. The name Ansar carries the meaning “Helpers, Supporters” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Ansar usually hope their child will grow to embody helpers, supporters and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes sacrifice, unity, and unconditional help — the soul of one who uplifts others in times of need.
data.etymology: Ansar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helpers, Supporters.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ansar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

celebrity_usage: Historical title for supporters of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
data.cultural_impact: The Ansar played a pivotal role in the early Islamic community, helping to establish the first Muslim state in Medina, providing protection and support to the Prophet and the Muhajiroun, who had fled Mecca. This name continues to be used as a term of respect and admiration for those who provide assistance and support to others, particularly within Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ansar holds great spiritual significance, as it represents the concept of women and men coming together in unity and selflessness to support the message of God through the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. In Islamic teachings, it serves as a reminder of the importance of brotherhood and sisterhood, along with providing practical assistance and support to one another. It ultimately represents the virtues of faith, compassion, and devotion to the divine message of Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ansar means "helpers" or "supporters" in Arabic. In Islamic context, it refers to the early Muslims of Medina who gave shelter and protection to Prophet Muhammad and the Muslim migrants from Mecca. They were the first converts to Islam in Medina and formed a strong community that helped establish the first Islamic state. Thus, Ansar symbolizes unity, support, and strength in the face of adversity.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ansar were the supporters of the Prophet Muhammad in Medina. The name Ansar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ansar were the early converts to Islam in Medina. They provided shelter, food, and protection to the Prophet Muhammad and his companions when they migrated from Mecca to Medina in 622 AD.
